share_basis: Exact FY26 audited and June2026 shareholder count, unchanged rounded September capital. No claim of a fresh November capital audit.
units: INR crore except share prices and shares

sales_and_profit_convention.core_sales: Gross economic turnover of the existing/expanded upstream and core portfolio, including market-equivalent internal ECH/chlorotoluene transfers when relevant.
sales_and_profit_convention.new_downstream_sales: External sales of new downstream output. Its modeled margin is incremental after a market-equivalent charge for captive upstream feedstock.
sales_and_profit_convention.summed_sales: Pre-elimination gross turnover proxy, NOT consolidated external revenue. No claim that3550+1000 is a verified product sales bridge.
sales_and_profit_convention.profit: Core contribution includes upstream margin on captive material, downstream contribution is after transfer feedstock cost. No automatic subtraction of upstream economic profit merely because delivery is internal.
sales_and_profit_convention.uncertainty: No issuer product-level forecast reconciles these allocated sales/margins. The same total EBITDA could require a different product mix. Comparison of summed turnover with management consolidated revenue ambition is not proof of conservatism.
sales_and_profit_convention.working_capital: Model charges working capital against the gross growth proxy without a captive-elimination credit. This may overstate funding needs, but no precise external-turnover or incremental-revenue claim is made.

funding_status.description: Net-debt recurrence assumes facilities can finance the modeled cash deficits and replace scheduled amortization. Rated and proposed facilities are not irrevocable unrestricted project funding.
funding_status.principal_treatment: Principal repayment is a financing flow. To preserve model net debt, gross new/refinancing need equals closing net debt minus opening net debt plus scheduled principal, before cashbuffer or optional extra repayment.
funding_status.later_periods: Cash sweeps/prepayment and renewed workingcapital access are assumptions. Actual covenants, drawdown conditions and prepayment charges require review before capital deployment.

reserve_caveats.derivative: Analyst allowance, not exact Sept current+noncurrent fair value. March derivative liabilities27.71, Sept noncurrent9.24 and current portion not separately published.
reserve_caveats.tax_demand: Company contests demand. Full amount assumed paid in first forecast period, no refund benefit.
reserve_caveats.current_tax: Timing catch-up allowance57.33-43.35, not assertion all is immediately payable.
reserve_caveats.spv: 21.25 committed OCD less2.13 FY26 and5.31 H1FY27, equity0.13 already subscribed. Not part of PPE capex assumption.
